chunks: When We inspired to your mother what was inspired.
ai.seo_question: What was the divine inspiration given to the mother of Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to Maryam (Mary), mother of Prophet Isa (Jesus), highlighting the divine preparation of key maternal figures in prophetic history. The term 'wahy' here denotes a form of spiritual inspiration or revelation granted to her to ensure the proper preservation and upbringing of her son, mirroring the role of Amina in the life of Muhammad (PBUH). This connection underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the mothers of the prophets.
